state_edit_reproduction.source: agents.jsonl: P3-detune/Raw continuation-1 evaluation steps1 and2
state_edit_reproduction.method: Python dict union with the recorded patch, no API or simulation
state_edit_reproduction.first_reason: Full test: reduce end mass and increase both beam thicknesses to lower dynamic stress/travel and move mechanical resonance away from background.
state_edit_reproduction.second_reason: Moderate stiffening only: keep the original mass/power coupling but reduce tip travel and shift the resonance enough to lower peak stress.
state_edit_reproduction.conclusion: Deterministic no-op patch: h was already1.1; mass_g restoration4.65 was mentioned in reason but omitted from changes, leaving2.0. This proves a state-edit mismatch on this trace, not a general model incapacity or physical infeasibility.

model_found_witness.recorded_reason: Energy-starved: ~100uW harvest can't sustain dense peeking or fast recovery after the ~300uJ TX drain, so the 10s fault was missed. Lower diode-bridge series resistance 5->0.5k to raise rectified power (no resonance shift), lower peek gate to 0.20 to reliably catch fault RMS, keep peek 2ms, poll 65ms. Goal: sustain ~170uW so ~70-80 peeks span the run and recovery between 8s and 10s completes.
model_found_witness.trajectory: Initial without precheck0/2 -> step1 2ms precheck1/2 -> step2 bridge/poll/threshold jointchange2/2 fullPASS

energy_interpretation.limit: No integratedenergy/harvestpower in these toolresults. Nominalcontinuous65ms duty is not measuredaverage: node can waitforvoltagerecovery. Do not treatmodel170uW reason asverifiedphysics.

model_found_witness.conclusion: There is now an actual full-transient feasiblewitness withoutauxiliaryhardware, foundbyRawmodel in2validdesigns. Earlierfour developerrefs lackedawitness atthatpointintime; theydidnotshowglobalimpossibility. Threeparameters changedtogether, so isolatedbenefit ofresistance/threshold/polltimingisnotidentified. This is joint existingcircuit+software repair, not softwareonlyorproposedpolicyadvantage.
model_found_witness.claim_boundary: Fixed11secondtrace withtargets8s/10s andnuisance9s; 128pt2048Hz classifierretained. Not unseentransfer, any-phasecapture, longrunenergyneutrality, or generalmechanismnecessityproof.
